title: What Stars Are Made Of
thumbnailPrompt: A breathtaking photorealistic image of a swirling nebula in deep space, its vibrant colors of blues, purples, and golds contrasting against the inky blackness. At the nebula's heart, a miniature Earth is nestled, seemingly protected by the cosmic cloud. Cinematic lighting emphasizes the nebula's depth and the Earth's fragility, creating a sense of wonder and intrigue, high-end documentary style.
infographicPrompts: A clean, modern cross-section diagram of a star, clearly labeling the core, radiative zone, and convective zone. Use contrasting colors to differentiate each layer. Style is minimalist and high-contrast for overlaying text later.
